timing_contract.internal_first_token_ready: request start through the benchmark's internal first-token D2H; includes tokenization, prompt H2D, and prefill, but the token is not yielded to the caller
timing_contract.prompt_h2d: Reactant.to_rarray of the runtime prompt token matrix, measured inside every request
timing_contract.decode_state_h2d: Reactant.to_rarray of fresh position and generated-token state; runs after internal first-token timing and prevents donated state from leaking between requests
timing_contract.bulk_decode: all post-first-token steps execute in one PJRT invocation containing a StableHLO while; there is no intermediate token D2H, and one generated-token vector is copied to host at the end
timing_contract.request: in-process wall time until the complete 32-token result and decoded text are available

source.description: Exact no-thinking Qwen3 prompts for a cache-busted E2E comparison. The first Chinese character is one tokenizer token and changes for every performance request, preventing cross-request prefix-cache reuse.

phase_plan.scheduling: one request per case in JSON order after XLA compilation
phase_plan.cold_definition: first post-compilation request; load, transfer, and XLA compile are reported separately
phase_plan.semantic_smoke_policy: execute when token length matches the compiled performance shape; otherwise record a skip and use the canonical single-prompt result for semantic verification

case_results.skip_reason: semantic_smoke has 17 prompt tokens, but the compiled performance shape requires 18; semantic verification is covered by the canonical single-prompt benchmark result
case_results.name: canonical
